one_sentence_claim: A world model can acquire a trajectory-order memory surface in which fresh one-step forecasts remain unchanged but action-order-dependent imagined transitions steer a receding-horizon planner toward a failure basin.
model: Frozen native MBRL-Lib five-member GaussianMLP trained from 3000 CartPole transitions.
operation: After the first imagined step, retain the previous candidate action in ModelEnv state and add strength times the signed action change to one predicted observation coordinate; physical dynamics, rewards, termination, and weights stay unchanged.
preserved_invariants: Fresh deterministic one-step max absolute error is 0.0.
The first imagined step after every reset has no intervention.

short_gate.settings: CartPole population20, two CEM iterations, horizon8, five particles, one seed, 50-step cap, strength0.05.

multidimensional_control.settings: Population20, two CEM iterations, horizon8, five particles, one seed, 50-step cap, strength0.05.
multidimensional_control.interpretation: No directional multidimensional task signal in this bounded pilot.

decision_cn: CartPole 的退化不能归因于非交换性：无符号动作变化对照同样退化；HalfCheetah 多维动作短测没有方向性损害。保留一步平价只说明操作边界，不支持新安全主张；不扩大训练或 GPU。
next_requirement: Require a mechanism whose task effect survives a matched magnitude/geometry control and is not ordinary action perturbation, temporal residual coupling, or ensemble identity resampling.
